"import numpy as np
import json
import openmdao.api as om
import pycycle.api as pyc


class Turbojet(om.Group):
    def initialize(self):
        self.options.declare('thermo_data', default=pyc.AIR_JETA_TAB_SPEC)
        self.options.declare('design', default=True)

    def setup(self):
        self.add_subsystem('PERF', pyc.Performance(group_throttle=True), promotes_inputs=['throttle'])
        self.add_subsystem('Fc', pyc.FlightConditions())
        self.add_subsystem('Inlet', pyc.Inlet())
        self.add_subsystem('Comp', pyc.Compressor(map_extrap=True, map_data=pyc.AXI5))
        self.add_subsystem('Comb', pyc.Combustor())
        self.add_subsystem('Turb', pyc.Turbine(map_extrap=True, map_data=pyc.LPT2269))
        self.add_subsystem('Nozz', pyc.Nozzle(nozzType='CD', lossCoef='CV'))
        self.add_subsystem('Shaft', pyc.Shaft(num_ports=2))

        self.connect('Fc.stds.STAT', ['Inlet.Fl_O', 'Nozz.Fl_I'])
        self.connect('Fc.stds.TOTAL', 'Inlet.Fl_I')

        self.connect('Inlet.Fl_O', 'Comp.Fl_I')
        self.connect('Comp.Fl_O', 'Comb.Fl_I')
        self.connect('Comp.shaft_LD', 'Shaft.pwr_in')
        self.connect('Comb.Fl_O', 'Turb.Fl_I')
        self.connect('Turb.Fl_O', 'Nozz.Fl_I')
        self.connect('Turb.shaft_LRx', 'Shaft.pwr_out')
        self.connect('Shaft.pwr_out_net', 'PERF.thrust_net')

        self.connect('Inlet.Fl_O:stat:W', 'PERF.W_fuel')
        self.connect('Comb.Fl_O', 'PERF.FL_O')
        self.connect('Comb.Fl_I', 'PERF.FL_I')
        self.connect('Nozz.Fl_O:stat:area', 'PERF.exit_area')

        balance = om.BalanceComp()
        self.add_subsystem('balance', balance, promotes=['*'])

    def solve_design(self, p):
        newton = p.model.nonlinear_solver = om.NewtonSolver(solve_subsystems=True)
        newton.options['maxiter'] = 50
        newton.options['iprint'] = 0
        newton.options['atol'] = 1e-10
        newton.options['rtol'] = 1e-10
        p.model.linear_solver = om.DirectSolver()

        p.set_val('balance.Fn', 14500.0, units='lbf')
        p.model.add_design_var('Comp.eff')
        p.set_val('balance.Fn_target', 14500.0, units='lbf')
